rv.q: While the cast and crew did a splendid job with the entire production from top to bottom, The Wild Party is not a show for the faint of heart.
If you need a jazz wail to wake you up just before the world comes crashing down, Blank's got your wake-up call.
Standout vocals and top-notch choreography make The Wild Party a night of fun.
Though the production is amusing, two hours is a long time to watch 14 people partying.
But, in general, no one is doing their best work in this production.

cn.t: Blank Theatre's intimate production of Lippa's dark 1920s musical earns mixed-to-positive reviews for its strong vocals and uncomfortable atmosphere, though critics remain divided on the show's overall impact.
